Subject: Draft MAP & stakeholder RACI — next steps

Hi Sophia / Adrian —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) based on our discovery: milestones, suggested owners, and dependencies. High-level asks below; MAP file attached (FP_MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx).

Quick recap of what we heard:
- Goal: Replace legacy in-house model infra and centralize inference to reduce unit cost 35% and improve 99th percentile latency for customer-facing flows.
- Target integration: public checkout flow + risk-scoring microservice (Phase 1).
- Target close: end of Q2 (suggested 2026-06-30) if procurement and security validation align.

Proposed MAP milestones (short):
1) Contract & SOW sign — owner: Economic buyer (Adrian) — target: 2026-05-15 — dependency: procurement T&Cs + pricing approval
2) Security Review & SOC2 evidence exchange — owner: Security owner (Sophia) — target: 2026-04-15 — dependency: share SOC2 summary + infra diagrams
3) Pilot deployment (staging) + performance validation — owner: Eng lead (Vivek) + Redwood SE (Rishi) — target: 2026-05-01 — dependency: access to test dataset and staging creds
4) Production cutover & runbook handoff — owner: Eng lead (Vivek) — target: 2026-06-15 — dependency: canary success metrics and rollback plan

I also sketched a RACI table in the RACI workbook: economic buyer, security owner, legal owner, eng lead mapped to specific rows. Please confirm or correct the people below so we can lock milestones and escalation paths.

Current stakeholder mapping (please confirm):
- Economic buyer: Adrian Keller (VP of Procurement)
- Security owner: Sophia Martinez (Head of Security & Compliance)
- Legal owner: (I'm presuming) Kayla Ortiz (Contracts) — I don't have her on this thread; if different, please advise
- Eng lead: Vivek Kulkarni (Director, Platform)

Next steps I propose:
- Sophia: confirm security owner and a first pass on evidence items we need to provide (I attached \"FinPartners_SOC2_Summary.pdf\" for your reference).
- Adrian: confirm procurement timeline and any corporate procurement constraints we should know about.
- Vivek / Rishi: confirm the dependency list for pilot (data access, API keys, test scenarios).
- Laura (cc'd Legal): quick read of any initial contract redlines we should expect.

Attachments: FP_MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), FP_RACI_matrix_v1.xlsx (RACI), FinPartners_SOC2_Summary.pdf

Thanks — I can update the MAP in Drive and re-share a version with date stamps once we confirm owners.

Best,
Marissa Cole

So your suggested target close 2026-06-30 is OK, but we should aim to have contract and SOW signed by 2026-05-15 as milestone 1.

I can give a first-pass checklist by 2026-03-05.

I'll loop Kayla separately; she prefers contract redlines via DocuSign or tracked PDF.

—Sophia

Marissa / Vivek —

Quick technical note on pilot dependencies and an ETA for staging validation:

Dependencies we need from FinPartners to start pilot work:
- Staging API keys and a test tenant (read/write) — ideally by 2026-03-15
- Representative test dataset (anonymized) for performance and regression tests — by 2026-03-22
- A point-of-contact for data ingestion issues (one engineer) — named or on-call during ramp
- Baseline perf metrics for current infra (99th percentile latency, QPS) — helps us set success thresholds

Estimates for Redwood work (assuming dependencies met):
- Integration & data hookup (2 weeks)
- Performance tuning and KV/prefix caching validation (1 week)
- End-to-end regression checks + reporting (1 week)
Total: ~4 weeks from access.

So if FinPartners can provide keys and dataset by 2026-03-22, we can target staging validation complete by ~2026-04-19, giving time for a May pilot window. If any of those items slip, pilot pushes out accordingly.

I'll also prepare a one-page pilot success criteria doc and upload to the Drive folder by 2026-03-03.

Thanks,
